items.title: Does forcing one shared definition actually stay cheaper as more teams get involved?
items.description: An illustrative model, not a precise cost formula for any real organization — but it captures a real pattern. Forcing every team onto one shared definition means every PAIR of teams needs their differing assumptions reconciled against each other, which grows fast as teams are added. Bounded contexts cost roughly one boundary (a name plus a translation) per team instead. Drag the slider to see where the two approaches cross over, starting from Billing and Support's own 2-team situation.
items.compute: const sharedModelConflicts = Math.round(params.numTeams * (params.numTeams - 1) / 2); const boundedContextBoundaries = params.numTeams; return { sharedModelConflicts, boundedContextBoundaries };
